We are an inclusive Multi Sensory play space in Leyland, Lancashire. Just off M6 Junction 28.​

​

​We are a safe space created for families to

explore and play in a welcoming and calm sensory environment.​​​​​

​​​​Refunds or transfer of booking due to illness can be issued with 24 hours notice prior to session.

If notice is less than 24 hours, we will open the slot for a replacement booking to be made.

If slot is filled, a refund will be issued.

​

Babies 2 months and under are free with a full paying sibling.

Babies over two months are the standard fee or discounted with a full paying sibling.

Preparing for your visit

We recommend you use postcode for Sumner Street car park next to our building PR25 2LD

We suggest downloading Mipermit app as the parking machine can be temperamental.

 

We recognise that transitions to new places can cause challenges for some so we have photos and videos of each room. We have visuals of our space in the entrance so please take one to use to prepare for your next visit.

Our Rooms

​Our Playroom includes role play areas. Construction, Car Garage, Vets, Supermarket and Home corner.

Playroom

Sensory Room

Our sensory room provides a safe environment for Sensory exploration and relaxation.

Multi Sensory Room

A calm space with low lighting, interactive resources and a Sensory Slide and Ball pit.

Sensory Gym

Our sensory Gym hosts a wide range of equipment to encourage movement, improve co-ordination and provide Vestibular and Proprioceptive input. It provides a safe environment that promotes physical development and well being.

​Through inclusive, sensory play, we nurture connection, confidence and growth for all children. Our purpose built Sensory room, Sensory Gym, Playroom and Multi-Sensory room have all been created with purposeful considerations for those with additional needs in order to support everyone to Thrive!​

    I brought my three children here and they all absolutely loved it! staff were really friendly and chatted and played with the children. there was so much for the children to do and it was lovely and clean. highly recommended it and can't wait for our next visit!!

    *****

    Heather - Google Review

    Had our daughter's 4th birthday at AllThrive today and it was brilliant! Honestly didn't know what to expect but the whole thing was so relaxed. Nothing was too much trouble and you could tell the staff actually cared about making sure everyone had a good time. We had kids from 18 months to 9 years old which I was worried about, but they've got different rooms set up so there was genuinely something for all of them. No one was bored or left out. Deana who runs it is just lovely - really welcoming and you can see she's passionate about what she's doing. Makes such a difference when someone actually loves their job. All the other parents kept saying how much their kids were enjoying it, which is always a good sign! My daughter had the best time and I actually got to relax for once instead of stressing about whether everything was going okay. Would definitely recommend if you're looking for a party venue. We'll be back for sure.

    *****

    Lorraine - Google Review

    Visied on Monday with my friend and 11 month old. What an amazing place this is. Something for all children and there is nothing that could make it a better experience.
